data_point: Series D or later, or public
run_when: Funding information is on the site, or the rules found a late-stage clue.

prompt.task: Decide whether THIS company has raised a Series D or later round, or is publicly traded.
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Founders up to and including Series C are in the services ICP; Series D, later rounds and public companies are not.
yes_when: The company says it raised a Series D, E or later round
The company shows its own stock ticker, says it is publicly traded, or announces its IPO
no_when: The text confirms the latest round is Series C or earlier
unknown_when: Only size, polish or customer logos suggest the company is large
A large round with no letter named
watch_out_for: A Series C is NOT a Series D: answer no when the latest round is Series C
A subsidiary of a public company: answer 'unknown' and explain in the reason
A tender offer or secondary sale is not a funding round
The evidence quote must itself show the round letter, the IPO or the listing

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" "Series D" OR "Series E" OR IPO OR NASDAQ OR NYSE
web_search.note: An exclusion found on the web counts only with high confidence and an entity match by domain.
